name: Black Eye

pages.text: In an active campaign, earn from the recorded victory over Sirok, The Sandworm.

pages.title: Obtaining in JEM
pages.text: In an active campaign this Eye belongs to the recorded victory over Sirok, The Sandworm. Older Eye recipes are removed when the complete campaign content is installed. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.

pages.title: End portal
pages.text: Use the matching Eye on an End Portal Frame. During an active campaign, an ordinary Eye of Ender locates the stronghold but does not fill its frames. End Remastered Eyes outside the twelve-eye roster are also unsuitable.

pages.title: Recovery
pages.text: After losing earned Eyes, sneak and interact empty-handed with an End Portal Frame. The campaign owner restores missing Eyes for already-defeated main bosses; this does not create new victories.

pages.title: World mode
pages.text: The campaign must be active with its required registrations. A new world with an inactive campaign retains the vanilla portal route. $(l:handbook/bosses/block_factorys_bosses/sandworm)Boss conditions and preparation$(/l).
